claims.source: H.R. 2670 as passed by the Senate, Division I
claims.text: The Senate-passed version of the FY2024 NDAA contained Division I, the 'Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena Disclosure Act of 2023' (Sections 9001-9010), including a Review Board and eminent domain over recovered technologies of unknown origin.

The President John F. Kennedy Assassination Records Collection Act of 1992 is the statutory template: a presumption of immediate disclosure, a defined collection at NARA, and an independent Review Board empowered to override agency withholding.
GAO reported in 1995 that Roswell AAF outgoing messages for 1946-1949 had been destroyed with no disposition authority and no destruction certificate.

connections.label: The Cover-Up
connections.note: GAO found Roswell AAF outgoing messages for 1946-1949 destroyed with no disposition authority and no destruction certificate - concealment executed through the records system.

connections.label: Freedom of Information Practice
connections.note: Before the FY2024 records provisions, FOIA was the only routine extraction mechanism; the NARA collection is an attempt to replace adversarial requesting with an affirmative duty.

connections.edgeLabel: The corpus is what survives the records fight
connections.label: Historiography
connections.note: Almost every primary document in this field arrived through FOIA or archival release; historiography here is downstream of records law.

connections.edgeLabel: Records law as the oversight instrument that worked
connections.label: Congressional Oversight
connections.note: Subtitle C of P.L. 118-31 is the only binding UAP transparency outcome Congress has produced, and it operates through records custody rather than through programme access.

connections.edgeLabel: Records destroyed January 1973; a misfiled finance set survived
connections.label: Project MKULTRA
connections.note: The destruction is recorded in the 1977 hearing print, and so is the accident that defeated it: finance folders sent to the Retired Records Center in 1970 outside normal procedure were missed in 1973 and again in 1975 and found in 1977.

connections.edgeLabel: Ordered the destruction of the MKULTRA files, January 1973
connections.label: Sidney Gottlieb
connections.note: The 1977 CIA memorandum reprinted in the hearing print says he retrieved and destroyed all the MKULTRA documents he was able to locate, which is why the 1973 and 1975 searches found nothing.

desc: Whoever controls the records controls the history, and this is the one front on which the disclosure movement has produced enacted law. Subtitle C of the FY2024 National Defense Authorization Act (P.L. 118-31) created, in Section 1841, an Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena Records Collection at the National Archives; in Section 1842, an affirmative duty on every government office to review, identify and transmit UAP records to NARA; and in Section 1843, grounds for postponement - a framework in which withholding is temporary and must be justified rather than permanent and unexplained. The model is the President John F. Kennedy Assassination Records Collection Act of 1992, which is why the Senate's original UAP Disclosure Act of 2023 also proposed an independent Review Board with the power to order release over agency objection; that Review Board and the eminent-domain provision over recovered material were stripped before enactment. What survived is a records statute without an independent adjudicator, which places the postponement decision back inside the agencies that hold the records. The stakes are set by the documented history: GAO found in 1995 that Roswell Army Air Field's outgoing messages for 1946-1949 had been destroyed with no destruction certificate. Scoring high on this domain means an entity holds, transfers, withholds or destroys records - or wrote the law governing those acts.
